title: Reject self-serve shell output from a failed process

lineage.failure_signature: ShellCommandRunner admitted non-empty stdout when the child process exited nonzero

command: import sys; print('DECISION: REFUSE'); print('synthetic diagnostic', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(7)

steps: Run the synthetic command through ShellCommandRunner.
Confirm only output digests and byte counts remain while result.ok is false.
Confirm score admission rejects the result and the CLI publishes no score artifacts.

expected_invariant: A shell attempt is scoreable only when exit metadata is an exact integer zero; incomplete attempts publish no report, summary, badge, or zero exit status.

admission.scope: Operator-authorized regression admission only; this is not independent review or custody.
